complexity.notes: Concise and idiomatic; the XOR check cleanly handles the one-null case. Recursion depth equals tree height, so worst-case space is O(n) for a skewed tree (O(log n) for balanced).
complexity.summary: Recursive structural comparison: returns True when both nodes are null, False when exactly one is null, and otherwise checks value equality plus recursive equality of both subtrees with short-circuit evaluation.
